title: Multigenerational Family Posing Outdoors, 1930s Rural Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a large multigenerational American family standing along a paved rural road on a bright day. The group spans four generations, from a crouching father supporting a small toddler on the far left, to young school-age children in front, to middle-aged adults and grandparents dressed in Depression-era formal and everyday attire. The backdrop features rolling pastureland, a simple post-and-rail wooden fence, and pine trees. The reverse side exhibits black paper album mounting residue at the corners with no inscriptions.
